data.config.yaml:
exporters:
  otlp_grpc:
    endpoint: ${env:KARTHOS_GATEWAY_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
    tls:
      insecure: true
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8s_attributes:
    auth_type: serviceAccount
    passthrough: false
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      key: k8s.node.name
      value: ${env:K8S_NODE_NAME}
  transform/karthos-source:
    metric_statements:
    - context: datapoint
      statements:
      - set(datapoint.attributes["karthos_source"], "host-os") where (IsMatch(metric.name,
        "^system\\.")) and datapoint.attributes["karthos_source"] == nil
      - set(datapoint.attributes["karthos_source"], "kubelet") where (IsMatch(metric.name,
        "^container\\.") or IsMatch(metric.name, "^k8s\\.node\\.(cpu\\.usage|memory\\.working_set)$")
        or IsMatch(metric.name, "^k8s\\.pod\\.(cpu|memory)\\.") or IsMatch(metric.name,
        "^k8s\\.volume\\.")) and datapoint.attributes["karthos_source"] == nil
receivers:
  host_metrics:
    collection_interval: 30s
    root_path: /hostfs
    scrapers:
      cpu:
        metrics:
          system.cpu.utilization:
            enabled: true
      disk: {}
      filesystem:
        metrics:
          system.filesystem.utilization:
            enabled: true
      memory: {}
      network: {}
  kubelet_stats:
    auth_type: serviceAccount
    collection_interval: 30s
    endpoint: https://${env:K8S_NODE_NAME}:10250
    extra_metadata_labels:
    - k8s.volume.type
    insecure_skip_verify: true
    metric_groups:
    - container
    - node
    - pod
    - volume
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  pipelines:
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - otlp_grpc
      processors:
      - resource
      - k8s_attributes
      - transform/karthos-source
      - batch
      receivers:
      - host_metrics
      - kubelet_stats
    traces:
      exporters:
      - otlp_grpc
      processors:
      - resource
      - k8s_attributes
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
  telemetry:
    logs:
      encoding: json
      level: info
      output_paths:
      - stdout

connectors:
  service_graph:
    dimensions:
    - http.method
    - k8s.namespace.name
    latency_histogram_buckets:
    - 100ms
    - 250ms
    - 500ms
    - 1s
    - 5s
    metrics_flush_interval: 15s
    store:
      max_items: 10000
      ttl: 30s
exporters:
  otlp_grpc:
    endpoint: ${env:KARTHOS_BACKEND_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
    sending_queue:
      enabled: true
    tls:
      insecure: true
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_percentage: 75
    spike_limit_percentage: 15
  transform/karthos-servicegraph-namespace:
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - set(span.attributes["k8s.namespace.name"], resource.attributes["k8s.namespace.name"])
        where span.attributes["k8s.namespace.name"] == nil and resource.attributes["k8s.namespace.name"]
        != nil
  transform/karthos-source:
    metric_statements:
    - context: datapoint
      statements:
      - set(datapoint.attributes["karthos_source"], "kube-cluster") where (metric.name
        == "k8s.container.cpu_limit" or metric.name == "k8s.container.cpu_request"
        or metric.name == "k8s.container.memory_limit" or metric.name == "k8s.container.memory_request"
        or metric.name == "k8s.container.ready" or metric.name == "k8s.container.restarts"
        or metric.name == "k8s.node.condition" or metric.name == "k8s.pod.phase" or
        metric.name == "k8s.pod.status_reason") and datapoint.attributes["karthos_source"]
        == nil
      - set(datapoint.attributes["karthos_source"], "traces.servicegraph") where (IsMatch(metric.name,
        "^traces\\.service\\.graph\\.") or IsMatch(metric.name, "^traces_service_graph_"))
        and datapoint.attributes["karthos_source"] == nil
receivers:
  k8s_cluster:
    collection_interval: 30s
    metrics:
      k8s.container.cpu_limit:
        enabled: true
      k8s.container.cpu_request:
        enabled: true
      k8s.container.ephemeralstorage_limit:
        enabled: false
      k8s.container.ephemeralstorage_request:
        enabled: false
      k8s.container.memory_limit:
        enabled: true
      k8s.container.memory_request:
        enabled: true
      k8s.container.ready:
        enabled: true
      k8s.container.restarts:

        enabled: false
      k8s.daemonset.misscheduled_nodes:
        enabled: false
      k8s.daemonset.ready_nodes:
        enabled: false
      k8s.deployment.available:
        enabled: false
      k8s.deployment.desired:
        enabled: false
      k8s.hpa.current_replicas:
        enabled: false
      k8s.hpa.desired_replicas:
        enabled: false
      k8s.hpa.max_replicas:
        enabled: false
      k8s.hpa.min_replicas:
        enabled: false
      k8s.job.active_pods:
        enabled: false
      k8s.job.desired_successful_pods:
        enabled: false
      k8s.job.failed_pods:
        enabled: false
      k8s.job.max_parallel_pods:
        enabled: false
      k8s.job.successful_pods:
        enabled: false
      k8s.namespace.phase:
        enabled: false
      k8s.node.condition:
        enabled: true
      k8s.persistentvolume.status.phase:
        enabled: false
      k8s.persistentvolume.storage.capacity:
        enabled: false
      k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.status.phase:
        enabled: false
      k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.storage.capacity:
        enabled: false
      k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.storage.request:
        enabled: false
      k8s.pod.phase:
        enabled: true
      k8s.pod.status_reason:
        enabled: true

        enabled: false
      k8s.replicaset.desired:
        enabled: false

        enabled: false
      k8s.replication_controller.desired:
        enabled: false

        enabled: false
      k8s.resource_quota.used:
        enabled: false
      k8s.service.endpoint.count:
        enabled: false
      k8s.service.load_balancer.ingress.count:
        enabled: false

      k8s.statefulset.desired_pods:

      k8s.statefulset.updated_pods:

      openshift.clusterquota.limit:
        enabled: false
      openshift.clusterquota.used:
        enabled: false
    node_conditions_to_report:
    - DiskPressure
    - MemoryPressure
    - Ready
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318

      - k8s_cluster

    metrics/otlp:

  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: mesh-istio
        kubernetes_sd_configs:
        - role: pod
        metric_relabel_configs:
        - action: keep
          regex: istio_(requests_total|request_duration_milliseconds(_bucket|_sum|_count)?|request_messages_total|response_messages_total|tcp_connections_(opened|closed)_total|tcp_(sent|received)_bytes_total)
          source_labels:
          - __name__
        - action: keep
          regex: destination
          source_labels:
          - reporter
        - replacement: mesh.istio
          target_label: karthos_source
        - source_labels:
          - source_canonical_service
          target_label: client
        - source_labels:
          - source_workload_namespace
          target_label: client_namespace
        - source_labels:
          - destination_canonical_service
          target_label: server
        - source_labels:
          - destination_service_namespace
          target_label: server_namespace
        - source_labels:
          - request_protocol
          target_label: network_protocol_name
        - source_labels:
          - response_code
          target_label: http_response_status_code
        - source_labels:
          - grpc_response_status
          target_label: rpc_grpc_status_code
        - source_labels:
          - connection_security_policy
          target_label: mesh_security_policy
        - source_labels:
          - source_principal
          target_label: mesh_peer_source_principal
        - source_labels:
          - destination_principal
          target_label: mesh_peer_destination_principal
        - source_labels:
          - response_flags
          target_label: mesh_envoy_response_flags
        metrics_path: /stats/prometheus
        relabel_configs:
        - action: keep
          regex: istio-proxy
          source_labels:
          - __meta_kubernetes_pod_container_name
        - action: keep
          regex: ^\Q${env:K8S_NODE_NAME}\E$
          source_labels:
          - __meta_kubernetes_pod_node_name
        - regex: ([^:]+)(?::\d+)?
          replacement: $1:15020
          source_labels:
          - __address__
          target_label: __address__
        - action: keep
          regex: karthos-eval-astronomy
          source_labels:
          - __meta_kubernetes_namespace
        scrape_interval: 15s
